name: Heimdall
description: Dashboard for all your web apps and links with live app stats where supported. Clean cards, tags and enhanced apps.
compose:
services:
  heimdall:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/heimdall:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
